mechanism_narrative: Persistent decline in TRANSIT mobility (-34.1% at t-0w, worsening from -30.4%) signals sustained commuting suppression. evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT declined from -30.4% to -34.1% over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases or remains flat over the next 28 days despite TRANSIT remaining below -30% for all four weeks.

evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL increased from +7.4% to +9.0% over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days while RESIDENTIAL remains above +8% for all four weeks.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC declines over the next 14 days when PARKS is below -5% and TRANSIT is below -30%, or PARKS recovers above 0% within two weeks.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days when GROCERY_PHARM remains between -2% and -5% and RESIDENTIAL stays above +8%.
